environment.notes: The launcher tries native GAP first, then WSL and Sage-environment GAP. The stored action is independently checked by the TypeScript certificate path before the viewer accepts it.

claims: The displayed degree-10 transitive action of I2(5) satisfies the Coxeter relations.
The stabilizer of a point is torsion-free: all prime-order conjugacy witnesses from the complete maximal spherical catalogue act without fixed points.
boundary: The bounded search does not prove that no lower-index action exists outside the checked range, although the spherical-order divisor supplies an exact necessary lower bound here.
The certificate does not claim normality, a canonical subgroup, manifold status, a map to Z, or PL Morse link conditions.
The quotient 3D placement remains a drawing convention.

environment.notes: The backend constructs integral Tits matrices in a cyclotomic field, reduces them modulo an exact prime ideal, and independently checks the emitted regular action in TypeScript.

claims: The degree-10 congruence image of I2(5) satisfies the Coxeter relations exactly over its finite residue field.
Reduction is injective on every maximal spherical special subgroup, so the congruence kernel is torsion-free by the finite-subgroup theorem for Coxeter groups.
boundary: The bounded prime-ideal search does not claim a canonical congruence quotient or a general minimum-index theorem.
The artifact does not establish a map to Z, PL Morse link conditions, or virtual algebraic fibering.
The generated quotient placement is a drawing convention.

environment.notes: A3 is retained as a finite rank-three regression case for exact spherical-restriction and action-export checks.

claims: The exact congruence image has degree 24 and preserves the full order of every maximal spherical restriction.
The emitted action passes a second exhaustive spherical-action certificate in the application code.
boundary: This finite regression artifact is not evidence about hyperbolic compact examples.
It does not claim a canonical subgroup, a map to Z, or PL Morse conclusions.

environment.runtime: GAP 4.14.0 through WSL plus deterministic Python composition
environment.notes: The direct search is deliberately capped below 10. Degree-2 and degree-5 transitive modules are combined on the reachable diagonal orbit, then independently recertified.

claims: The two factors jointly avoid all prime-order torsion witness classes in the complete I2(5) catalogue.
Their reachable diagonal orbit is a transitive degree-10 Coxeter action whose point stabilizer passes the independent torsion-free certificate.
boundary: The bounded set-cover search does not prove that its chosen factor family is globally optimal outside the enumerated module catalogue.
Composition does not by itself establish virtual algebraic fibering or any PL Morse condition.
The quotient 3D placement remains a drawing convention.

environment.notes: The isolated GAP toolchain pins TomLib, recog, genss, orb, ClassicalMaximals, and ferret. The compact report is extracted only after every requested degree row has a final outcome.

claims: Every multiple of 5,760 through 576,000 is classified for the exact characteristic-two image S3 x (O8^-(2):2).
Ninety-six degree rows are impossible by the complete index sieve; all 45 exact subgroup classes at the four remaining degrees contain a spherical torsion witness.
boundary: This finite-image report is not a nonexistence theorem for other congruence images or composite actions.
It does not supply a manageable torsion-free cover, a map to Z, or a virtual fibering certificate.

environment.notes: Uses Forms 1.3.0, GenSS 1.6.9, recog 1.5.1, and ClassicalMaximals 1.1. The stored GenSS/SLP equality proof was replayed independently before sealing.

claims: The characteristic-five image is an index-two extension of Omega+(10,5), of exact order 27,230,655,539,587,500,000,000,000,000,000.
The congruence kernel is finite index and torsion-free because every maximal spherical restriction is injective.
Every multiple of 5,760 through 576,000 is impossible as a transitive coset degree inside this finite image by the complete ClassicalMaximals root-index ledger.
boundary: The exact kernel is far too large to materialize as the desired manageable cover.
The bounded ledger applies only to this characteristic-five image and is not a global nonexistence theorem.
No wall coorientation, map to Z, or PL Morse link condition is claimed.
